declienting: Captured CN's `tag` rather than its `badge`: both resolve to the Badge canonical, but tag is the stronger implementation (101 lines, four test suites including two a11y) and carries the dismiss affordance the thinner one lacks.
Replaced the MaterialSymbol icon import with a startIcon slot, and kept the dismiss glyph as an inline SVG so there is no icon-set dependency.
Mapped the --color-button-tag-outline-* token family onto library semantic tokens; the outline treatment is now expressed with border-strong and text tokens rather than a bespoke palette.
Replaced the four getTagOutline*ClassName helper functions with inline class composition — they existed to thread a colorScheme through, which the surface prop now does directly.
Removed the separate decorative focus-ring span in favour of focus-visible on the button itself, so the ring follows the actual focus target.
Renamed colorScheme to surface and RemovableTag to Badge, matching the canonical.
Kept verbatim: the dismiss affordance, the `Remove ${label}` default accessible name, and the disabled handling.
